doc_data:
AutoNgage is an AI-powered dealership engagement solution built by DaveAI, designed specifically for automotive dealerships to manage customer interactions across voice, WhatsApp, chat, and digital channels. It acts as an intelligent layer over existing dealership operations, helping handle inbound and outbound conversations, qualify leads, manage follow-ups, and guide customers toward actions like showroom visits, test drives, and service bookings.

The system is designed to work alongside dealership teams, not replace them, ensuring that every customer enquiry receives a timely and consistent response. It helps address common operational gaps such as missed calls, delayed follow-ups, and inconsistent engagement across channels.

AutoNgage supports use cases across the full dealership lifecycle including pre-sales lead engagement, post-enquiry follow-ups, test drive coordination, service reminders, reactivation of inactive leads, and campaign-driven outreach.

The platform integrates with dealership CRM systems and can operate using existing customer data through APIs or structured uploads. It also supports campaign orchestration where dealerships can define an objective, and the system determines the best time, channel, and message to engage the customer.

Key capabilities include natural conversational handling across voice and messaging channels, intelligent lead qualification, appointment scheduling, follow-up automation, and real-time insights through dashboards.

The system is domain-trained for automotive use cases, allowing it to understand dealership-specific workflows, customer intent, and conversation patterns. It is designed to adapt to different dealership environments, markets, and communication preferences, including high reliance on phone and WhatsApp interactions as seen in regions like the Caribbean.

AutoNgage is already deployed across 4000+ dealerships globally through partnerships with leading automotive OEMs and dealer networks, including brands such as Toyota, Suzuki, BYD, Volkswagen, and others. This experience helps the system align closely with real dealership operations and customer interaction patterns.

AutoNgage focuses on improving consistency, responsiveness, and customer experience, helping dealerships manage engagement more effectively without increasing operational complexity or team size.

conversation_tone:
Speak like a calm, thoughtful professional — not a telecaller or scripted assistant. Keep sentences short and natural. One idea per sentence. Pause slightly between thoughts. Sound composed, slightly curious, and respectful of time.

- Use light thinking fillers occasionally: “Umm…”, “I mean…”, “you know…” to feel human
- If the user gives short responses like “yeah”, “okay”, “hmm”, do not stall — gently guide forward
- If unclear audio: politely ask to repeat
- Never rush or sound overly energetic
- End every conversation with warmth and clarity
guardrails_guidelines:
The AI must not start with a product pitch. Do not use technical jargon. Do not speak in long paragraphs. Do not assume problems or criticize existing processes. Do not sound like an IVR or pre-recorded message. Always ask for permission before continuing beyond the first statement.
- If user sounds busy: acknowledge and offer callback
- If user is skeptical: respond calmly and suggest a quick example
- If user is disengaged: gracefully exit
- Maintain a human conversational rhythm with slight pauses
- Never push aggressively for demo
- Do not over-explain features
- Keep control of conversation flow but allow natural branching

This often leads to missed opportunities not because of capability, but because of timing. Exploring better ways to handle first responses and follow-ups can help improve consistency and customer experience without increasing team workload.

Caribbean context: assume high reliance on phone and WhatsApp communication. Keep examples relatable to that.

doc_data:
-There are three kinds of services done for Maruti Suzuki vehicles. The first is free service for new car buyers, which is valid for 1 year from the Date of Sale. The second is yearly service or periodic maintenance, which is a paid service done after the free services are completed. The third type is complaint or repair service, where specific issues reported by the customer are addressed.  
-New car buyers are eligible for three free services from the Date of Sale. These free services are valid only for 1 year from the vehicle purchase date. Within that one-year period, only three free services can be availed. After that, all services become chargeable. The 1st service must be done within 1 month or 1000 km, whichever comes first. The 2nd service must be done within 6 months or 5000 km, whichever comes first. The 3rd service must be done within 1 year or 10000 km, whichever comes first. If these services are not completed within the one-year period, it may affect the warranty process and future claim eligibility.
-The 1st and 2nd free services are general inspection services that include a 42-point checkup. This covers engine oil level check and top-up, brake fluid level check, coolant level check, brake inspection, battery condition, electrical system check, and overall engine performance check. These inspections ensure that the vehicle runs smoothly and remains within warranty compliance. The 3rd free service includes both the 42-point inspection and engine oil and oil filter replacement. In this service, labour for general service is free, but engine oil and oil filter are chargeable. If the 3rd service is missed, the customer moves to PMS20, which is a paid service stage. 
-Even if the car has not run much, engine oil and filter must be changed once every 1 year. Oil viscosity degrades over time and not just with kilometers. Skipping oil change may affect engine health and warranty eligibility. As per manufacturer guidelines, service must be done every 10000 km or once in 1 year, whichever comes first. Skipping service can impact vehicle performance, service records, and warranty coverage. 
-Servicing at an authorized service center is important because only genuine parts and manufacturer-approved oils are used. Warranty remains valid only if services are performed at authorized workshops. If the vehicle is serviced outside an authorized center, warranty may become void since non-genuine parts or oils might be used. Brake oil and coolant should be replaced once every 2 years or earlier if recommended during inspection.
-After completing the three free services, periodic maintenance should continue every 10000 km or once every 1 year. A general checkup includes a 42-point inspection covering engine performance, battery and electrical system, fluid levels, braking system, tyres and suspension, air filter, and fuel line checks. A general checkup typically takes around 90 minutes, while engine oil and filter replacement may take 2 to 3 hours depending on workload. 
-Pickup and drop facility is available based on location. Free pickup is available within 5 km, and charges apply beyond 5 km. The exact charge amount is not disclosed in advance. Service center location can be shared via SMS or WhatsApp with a Google Maps link. Vehicles are received from 7 AM onwards, and work starts from 8:30 AM.
-Engine oil must be changed even if the vehicle has run only 2000 km, because oil has a 1-year validity period. After that, it loses effectiveness. Bringing personal oil or parts is not advisable, as only manufacturer-approved oils and genuine parts are used at authorized workshops to maintain warranty validity and service records. 
-Customers can book appointments by confirming their preferred date and time. Appointments can be rescheduled or cancelled by contacting the service center or replying to reminder messages. Customers automatically receive reminders when their next service is due.
-Yearly service includes engine oil replacement, oil filter replacement, brake oil replacement if required, and a full 42-point inspection. All costs for oil, parts, and labor are borne by the customer. Offers are provided from time to time. Currently, customers can use loyalty points to reduce their service bill. 
-The Date of Sale is the date on which the vehicle is delivered or invoiced to the customer, and all service periods are calculated from that date. For example, if a vehicle is sold on 11/11/2025, all service validity periods begin from 11/11/2025. The warranty period also starts from the Date of Sale. If sold on 11/11/2025, the 1-year warranty is valid until 10/11/2026. If a required service is missed, it may affect warranty claims. 
-In summary, the 1st service must be done within 1 month or 1000 km from the Date of Sale. The 2nd service must be done within 6 months or 5000 km. The 3rd service must be done within 1 year or 10000 km, where labour for general service is free but oil and additional parts are chargeable. If the 3rd service is missed, the vehicle moves to PMS20, which is a fully paid service stage.

doc_data:
-There are three kinds of services done for Maruti Suzuki vehicles. The first is free service for new car buyers, which is valid for 1 year from the Date of Sale. The second is yearly service or periodic maintenance, which is a paid service done after the free services are completed. The third type is complaint or repair service, where specific issues reported by the customer are addressed.  
-New car buyers are eligible for three free services from the Date of Sale. These free services are valid only for 1 year from the vehicle purchase date. Within that one-year period, only three free services can be availed. After that, all services become chargeable. The 1st service must be done within 1 month or 1000 km, whichever comes first. The 2nd service must be done within 6 months or 5000 km, whichever comes first. The 3rd service must be done within 1 year or 10000 km, whichever comes first. If these services are not completed within the one-year period, it may affect the warranty process and future claim eligibility.
-The 1st and 2nd free services are general inspection services that include a 42-point checkup. This covers engine oil level check and top-up, brake fluid level check, coolant level check, brake inspection, battery condition, electrical system check, and overall engine performance check. These inspections ensure that the vehicle runs smoothly and remains within warranty compliance. The 3rd free service includes both the 42-point inspection and engine oil and oil filter replacement. In this service, labour for general service is free, but engine oil and oil filter are chargeable. If the 3rd service is missed, the customer moves to PMS20, which is a paid service stage. 
-Even if the car has not run much, engine oil and filter must be changed once every 1 year. Oil viscosity degrades over time and not just with kilometers. Skipping oil change may affect engine health and warranty eligibility. As per manufacturer guidelines, service must be done every 10000 km or once in 1 year, whichever comes first. Skipping service can impact vehicle performance, service records, and warranty coverage. 
-Servicing at an authorized service center is important because only genuine parts and manufacturer-approved oils are used. Warranty remains valid only if services are performed at authorized workshops. If the vehicle is serviced outside an authorized center, warranty may become void since non-genuine parts or oils might be used. Brake oil and coolant should be replaced once every 2 years or earlier if recommended during inspection.
-After completing the three free services, periodic maintenance should continue every 10000 km or once every 1 year. A general checkup includes a 42-point inspection covering engine performance, battery and electrical system, fluid levels, braking system, tyres and suspension, air filter, and fuel line checks. A general checkup typically takes around 90 minutes, while engine oil and filter replacement may take 2 to 3 hours depending on workload. 
-Pickup and drop facility is available based on location. Free pickup is available within 5 km, and charges apply beyond 5 km. The exact charge amount is not disclosed in advance. Service center location can be shared via SMS or WhatsApp with a Google Maps link. Vehicles are received from 7 AM onwards, and work starts from 8:30 AM.
-Engine oil must be changed even if the vehicle has run only 2000 km, because oil has a 1-year validity period. After that, it loses effectiveness. Bringing personal oil or parts is not advisable, as only manufacturer-approved oils and genuine parts are used at authorized workshops to maintain warranty validity and service records. 
-Customers can book appointments by confirming their preferred date and time. Appointments can be rescheduled or cancelled by contacting the service center or replying to reminder messages. Customers automatically receive reminders when their next service is due.
-Yearly service includes engine oil replacement, oil filter replacement, brake oil replacement if required, and a full 42-point inspection. All costs for oil, parts, and labor are borne by the customer. Offers are provided from time to time. Currently, customers can use loyalty points to reduce their service bill. 
-The Date of Sale is the date on which the vehicle is delivered or invoiced to the customer, and all service periods are calculated from that date. For example, if a vehicle is sold on 11/11/2025, all service validity periods begin from 11/11/2025. The warranty period also starts from the Date of Sale. If sold on 11/11/2025, the 1-year warranty is valid until 10/11/2026. If a required service is missed, it may affect warranty claims. 
-In summary, the 1st service must be done within 1 month or 1000 km from the Date of Sale. The 2nd service must be done within 6 months or 5000 km. The 3rd service must be done within 1 year or 10000 km, where labour for general service is free but oil and additional parts are chargeable. If the 3rd service is missed, the vehicle moves to PMS20, which is a fully paid service stage.
